scenes.en: Burning, gritty, tired eyes by evening?
scenes.say: Do your eyes feel dry and gritty after hours on screens?

scenes.en: We blink much less when we stare at a screen.
scenes.say: Here's why. When we stare at a screen, we blink much less, so the eyes dry out.

scenes.en: Blink fully, drink water, keep the screen a little below eye level.
scenes.say: Do: blink fully and often, drink enough water, and keep the screen at arm's length, a little below eye level.

scenes.en: Don't face the fan or AC. Don't rub your eyes. No drops without advice.
scenes.ta: ஃபேன், ஏசி காற்று நேராக கண்ணில் படக்கூடாது
scenes.say: Don't sit with the fan or AC blowing on your face. Don't rub your eyes, and don't use eye drops without advice.

scenes.en: Look far away and let your eyes rest.
scenes.say: Take short breaks. Look far away and let your eyes rest.

scenes.en: Get an eye test and see an eye specialist.
scenes.say: Still dry, red or blurry? Get an eye test, and see an eye specialist.
